shader_generation: CMake builds six SPIR-V modules from the supplied GLSL sources using glslang; cmake/embed_spirv.cmake embeds them into the native executable.

observed_results.hardware_capabilities: OpenGL and Vulkan with hardware ray queries available on AMD RX7900XTX

source_build_dependencies: Authoritative CMake/pkg-config identifiers and development-prefix layout are documented in the source README. Game media is not required to build; it is required for original-asset checks and gameplay.

evidence_boundary: Observed source-to-native-ELF build; does not attest downstream dependency source completeness or retroactively clear an older AppImage. No full campaign or user-specific flicker/noise acceptance claimed.
